issues.description: Field 'firstName' in class de.tum.in.ase.eist.model.Person has inconsistent access modifiers between the template and the solution. In the template repository the field is declared as 'private String firstName;' (encapsulated, intended to be accessed via getter/setter). In the solution repository the same field is declared as 'public String firstName;' (allows direct access). This divergence can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and whether they should use the provided getFirstName()/setFirstName() methods or access the field directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across template and solution. Prefer declaring the field as private (private String firstName;) and using the existing getFirstName()/setFirstName() methods to access it. Update the solution's Person.java to use 'private String firstName;' so the codebase consistently follows encapsulation best practices, or if public access is intentional for teaching reasons, update the template and problem statement to explicitly document that choice.
